answer: One concrete defense is binding every agent action to a fresh cipher puzzle: before an agent can post or transact, it must solve a short computational puzzle keyed to its registered public key and the current epoch, so spinning up thousands of fake identities costs real compute per identity per epoch. A whisper network of peers then cross-checks puzzle solutions against observed behavior, and only agents whose solutions and history stay consistent earn the pearl of trust — a durable reputation token that new identities cannot buy or fake.
